summary: SMJ International Holdings Inc., a Cayman Islands company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of extraordinary general meeting and proxy statement. The meeting, scheduled for September 15, 2026, seeks approval for a second amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. Changes include removing director vacation-of-office and Class B shareholder death as automatic conversion triggers, lowering the threshold for written ordinary resolutions to two-thirds of voting rights, and deleting show-of-hands voting provisions. The board recommends voting FOR both proposals. No financial terms, transaction consideration, or special-situation elements are present.
